programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Last Exit to Springfield: Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control after Homer leads the workers on strike.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Whacking Day: Lisa asks singer Barry White to help stop the cruel Springfield 'Whacking Day' tradition of hitting snakes with sticks.

programme.title: The Simpsons
